role: independent factual reviewer; did not author or alter proposal

nodes.rationale: Accept the scoped fine-particle household dust meaning. DEX 2009 separates ordinary dust from specified powders and assigns the plural to its other senses. Dust need not be soil; suspended/settled is supported by the historical DLRLC physical sense. Salience 0.90 is editorial, not surveyed recognition.
nodes.form_evidence: Independently read DOR-attributed inflection table on dexonline. These are morphological forms, not synonyms.

nodes.rationale: Accept a tiny detached food piece, canonically bread and by extension other foods. Biscuit crumbs fit the extension. It is not dust, a synonym for bread, or a cooking ingredient recipe. Salience 0.90 is editorial.
nodes.form_evidence: Independently read DOR-attributed inflection table on dexonline. These are morphological forms, not synonyms.

nodes.rationale: Accept a short textile thread detached from fabric. Clothing/home textiles fit this sense. Historical dressings, botanical plural fluff, hair and generic fibre remain outside the owner. Salience 0.85 is editorial.
nodes.form_evidence: Independently read DOR-attributed inflection table on dexonline. These are morphological forms, not synonyms.

edges.rationale: Dust swept from a floor is collected in a dustpan. The label names a collection tool, not the best way to capture every airborne particle.
edges.strength_assessment: Strong direct ordinary use; 0.85 acceptable editorial estimate.

edges.label_ro: se strânge de pe podea cu mătura
edges.rationale: Floor dust can be gathered by sweeping. Sweeping can also stir dust up; the label promises collection, not total airborne-dust removal.
edges.strength_assessment: Strong direct use, 0.85; no universal efficiency claim.

edges.label_ro: poate fi colectat de pe podea de un mop cu microfibre
edges.rationale: The original Romanian Turbo 2in1 page explicitly describes microfiber fringes collecting floor dust. The edge retains both may and microfiber qualifications.
edges.strength_assessment: 0.80 is an acceptable qualified-use estimate; do not generalize to every mop.

edges.rationale: The existing target is explicitly a household floor/carpet suction appliance. It collects ordinary dust. Neither the broad dictionary entry nor this edge licenses vacuuming every substance.
edges.strength_assessment: 0.90 fits a defining household use; editorial, not a measured source score.

edges.label_ro: lasă bucățele mici când se taie sau se rupe
edges.rationale: DEX explicitly defines a small bread fragment left by cutting or breaking; the direction bread to crumb and description are factual.

edges.label_ro: poate lăsa bucățele mici la rupere sau consum
edges.rationale: DEX permits tiny pieces of other foods; original carpet care explicitly mentions biscuit crumbs. May leave crumbs on breaking/eating is a warranted synthesis.
edges.strength_assessment: 0.85 is a direct food-fragment association, not a recipe weight.

edges.label_ro: se adună de pe podea cu fărașul
edges.rationale: The dry-cleaning page includes floor crumbs and broom/dustpan sets, and the dictionary defines the collection implement. The floor qualifier excludes food preparation.
edges.strength_assessment: 0.80 is reasonable for collected dry debris; direction does not invent a reverse fact.

edges.label_ro: se îndepărtează de pe podele sau covoare cu
edges.rationale: Original care guidance names biscuit crumbs and routine/quick vacuum cleaning of carpets. The proposed floor/carpet collection use is supported.
edges.strength_assessment: 0.85 is direct household collection; no claim that every wet or large food remnant should be vacuumed.

edges.label_ro: poate lăsa fire textile scurte pe suprafață
edges.rationale: DEX defines threads from fabric and has clothing-context examples. Philips confirms garments develop pills. The may-shed label is accepted as a modest fabric-to-loose-thread association, without identifying attached pills with loose floor lint.
edges.strength_assessment: 0.80 is a qualified may association; not a claim about all garment materials.

edges.label_ro: poate forma fire textile scurte desprinse
edges.rationale: JUKKI explicitly anticipates scame during use of its bamboo/cotton blanket. DEX fixes the textile sense. Philips independently provides blanket-pilling context but is not used alone to prove detached lint.
edges.strength_assessment: 0.80 is acceptable only with the existing may-form qualification; no all-blankets claim.

edges.label_ro: unele covoare, mai ales din lână, lasă fire textile scurte
edges.rationale: IKEA Romanian wool-rug care explicitly says wool rugs produce scame naturally. The proposal says some carpets, especially wool, which preserves the material qualification.
edges.strength_assessment: 0.80 reflects a qualified material association, not a quantified shedding rate.

edges.label_ro: se îndepărtează de pe podele și covoare prin aspirare cu
edges.rationale: IKEA recommends vacuuming wool-rug lint; the original Kärcher article explicitly vacuums loose lint from floors and carpets. The edge keeps those locations and does not replace a garment shaver.
edges.strength_assessment: 0.85 is a direct loose-debris collection relation.

edges.label_ro: se curăță periodic prin aspirare cu
edges.rationale: Both original care pages recommend regular vacuuming of carpets. The statement is periodic care, not complete deep cleaning or permission for every attachment.

edges.label_ro: asigură energia de funcționare, din rețea sau acumulator
edges.rationale: Original VC manual Romanian pages 121–122 specify electrical connection and plugging into an outlet; the current family page specifies lithium-ion battery operation. The household target is electrically powered in both forms.
edges.strength_assessment: 0.85 is a direct energy requirement. The generic DEX entry alone does not establish electricity.

edges.label_ro: se poate spăla manual cu un burete de vase potrivit suprafeței
edges.rationale: DEX establishes the ordinary serving-plate object; FINO includes dishes in manual sponge washing and warns about abrasive sides. Surface-appropriate and can preserve that limitation.
edges.strength_assessment: 0.80 is a direct qualified manual-cleaning relation, not a claim that a sponge is mandatory.

edges.label_ro: umezește și clătește buretele folosit la spălarea vaselor
edges.rationale: FINO instructs rinsing/draining and discusses water during dishwashing; Vileda explicitly uses water and soap to wash the sponge. Wetting/rinsing is factual without a water-only disinfection claim.
edges.strength_assessment: 0.80 is a direct co-use association, not an Alchimie production fact.

edges.label_ro: poate contribui cu fibre la praful din casă
edges.rationale: The independently opened original manufacturer article explicitly includes carpet fibres in household dust. May contribute with fibres preserves the part-of-mixture relationship; dust and lint are not synonyms.
edges.strength_assessment: 0.70 is appropriately below defining tool associations because contribution depends on textile and setting; editorial only.

source_access_limits: All 18 author URLs were independently opened. Original Philips GCA2100 URL redirects with zero extractable text; the accepted review instead uses original GC026/00 PDF and a Romanian JUKKI blanket page.

Current Kärcher vacuum and robot category pages omit the authored carpet-fibre/lint passages. Same-publisher English On the Hunt for Dirt was independently opened and supports these facts. The Romanian legacy dust article intermittently failed on follow-up. These editions are not counted as independent publishers.
A first Philips GC026 PDF URL appeared in search/open metadata but its follow-up returned 404. It is not the bound supporting PDF; the alternative original 20211003 URL opened with full text.
The author-reported transient Farfurie access issue did not recur: the canonical entry independently opened with DEX 2009 text.
holds_and_boundaries: This accepts graph facts, not safe runtime application or any hidden-target promotion. Praf public projection identity/attempt continuity and all live score/typo/privacy behavior still require independent implementation review.
No prafuri: DEX limits that plural to other senses. No pulbere/colb, păr, murdărie, generic fibre, activity, diminutive or inferred synonym is approved here.
Praf de copt and Lapte praf remain existing distinct native owners. Bathroom Chiuvetă remains its existing native owner; no proposed edge touches it.
Scamă is not a universal name for hair, dust or plant fluff. Clothing pills may remain attached; the vacuum edge is limited to loose material on floors/carpets.
All edges are one-way and non-distractor. Sources establish semantic associations, not graph direction as a natural law or empirical numerical strengths.
No new node is proposed as a hidden target. Raw candidate keep/staging eligibility does not settle C1–C6, the prospective Burete plate-proxy debt, or rejection history.
No graph-truth judgment permits incidental crafting recipes or semantic shortcuts; root still must compare all old Alchimie/Lanț/derived content and all relevant Contexto feedback.
